title: Recipe 50 — Pro-grade Chat (à la ChatGPT): tools, routing, and a research sub-agent

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The assistant shape: browse, run code, look at an image — all declared, none of it bolted on at runtime.”

beats.label: Blank the scratch file
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed showcase is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — Step 1 is run it first.

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “A hundred and seventy-six lines for a full assistant. Read the tools block first — that's the whole capability surface.”

beats.label: Lint it in place
beats.cue: “Clean. Nothing about a browse tool or a Python sandbox is special to the schema.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Type the tools block
beats.cue: “Step 2: this is the whole capability surface. If it isn't here, the agent cannot do it — there is no runtime plugin path.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Declared capability, not discovered capability.”

beats.label: Type the Python allow rule
beats.cue: “Step 2, continued: Python runs sandboxed, so it's alwaysAllow. The sandbox is what earns the rule — not trust.”

beats.label: Type the web-researcher sub-agent
beats.cue: “Step 3: research fans out into a child with its own context, so a ten-page read doesn't evict your conversation.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “The child reports a summary back. The parent never sees the ten pages.”

beats.label: Find them in the bundle
beats.cue: “Tools, rules, and the sub-agent — all present as generated code.”

verify.note: the declared surface, as emitted code

beats.label: Read what got wired
beats.cue: “Every capability traceable from one YAML line to one emitted line.”

beats.label: Launch it
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The recipe's own five questions, in order — each one exercises a different tool.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a live model credential

beats.label: Ask something it just knows
beats.cue: [needs-key] “No tool call at all — a good assistant doesn't reach for a browser to answer this.”
beats.text: what's the capital of Burkina Faso?

beats.label: Ask it to run code
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 2's sandboxed Python — a chart comes back, and nothing ran on your machine.”
beats.text: /code plot the first 30 Fibonacci numbers on a log axis

beats.label: Ask it to show its work
beats.cue: [needs-key] “17! / 12! — watch whether it reasons or reaches for the sandbox. Both are defensible; the point is you can see which.”

beats.label: Exit
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

groups.title: One more thing · Step 6 — swap the model

beats.label: Find the model line
beats.cue: “One line. Everything else in the spec is provider-agnostic.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “A cheaper default is a defensible default for chat — the recipe says so, and says why.”

beats.label: Read the provider table
beats.cue: “OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock, local — same spec, different prefix.”
